en.basel-kadem: 5.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from his father, from Hammad bin Isa, from Huraiz, from Zurara, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, say:
The avaricious is only the one who prevented the right of Allah and spent in other than the right of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He.
